item.title: Bulletin updated at 11:30 HKT 25/Jul/2023
item.author: hkowm@hko.gov.hk (Hong Kong Observatory)
item.description:
General Situation:
Super Typhoon Doksuri will enter the northeastern part of the South China Sea tomorrow and gradually move towards the vicinity of the coast of eastern Guangdong and southern Fujian on Thursday and Friday. Under the influence of its outer subsiding air, very hot weather will persist over the southern China with showers and squally thunderstorms triggered by high temperatures in the next couple of days. Doksuri is expected to bring heavy squally showers to the coast of southeastern China in the latter part of this week. It will be windy over the region. Under the influence of a broad trough of low pressure over the northern part of the South China Sea, there will still be showers over the coast of southern China early to midweek next week.

Date/Month: 26/07 (Wednesday)
Wind: North to northwest force 3 to 4.
Weather: Sunny periods and one or two showers. Extremely hot during the day. Isolated squally thunderstorms later. There will be swells.
Temp range: 28 - 35 C
R.H. range: 60 - 95 per Cent
PSR: Medium Low
